sentences.text: Today I will talk about a very big and very interesting city.
The city is called Tokyo.
Tokyo is the capital city of Japan.
Japan is an island country in Asia.
Tokyo is one of the biggest cities in the world.
More than 13 million people live in Tokyo.
If you count the whole metropolitan area, it has more than 37 million people.
That makes Tokyo one of the largest cities on earth.
Tokyo is a city with a lot of history and modern life.
It is a city where old and new live together.
Let's talk about some famous places in Tokyo.
One famous place is Shibuya Crossing.
It is a very busy street crossing.
When the traffic light turns green, many people cross the street together.
It looks like a sea of people.
It is very popular with tourists.
Another famous place is the Tokyo Tower.
Tokyo Tower is tall and orange and white.
It looks like the Eiffel Tower in Paris.
You can go to the top and see a beautiful view of the city.
There is also the Tokyo Sky Tree.
It is the tallest tower in Japan.
You can see the city from very high up.
Tokyo has many temples and shrines.
One popular temple is Sensoji in the Asakusa area.
Sensoji is very old and has a big red gate called the Kaminaramon.
Many people visit this temple every year.
If you like nature, you can visit Weno Park.
Weno Park has many trees, flowers, museums, and a zoo.
In spring, people come to see the cherry blossoms.
Cherry blossoms are pink and white flowers.
They are very beautiful and important in Japan.
Tokyo is also famous for its technology.
Many companies make new gadgets and electronics in Tokyo.
People love technology and new ideas.
Fashion is very important in Tokyo.
Many young people like to wear different and colorful clothes.
There are many shopping areas like Harajuku and Ginza.
Let's talk about the food in Tokyo.
Tokyo has many delicious foods.
You can eat sushi, which is raw fish with rice.
You can eat ramen, a noodle soup with meat or vegetables.
Tempura is fried vegetables or seafood.
There are also many sweet desserts.
There are many restaurants, street food stands, and cafes.
You can find food from Japan and many other countries.
Tokyo has an excellent public transportation system.
There are many trains, subways, and buses.
The trains are very fast and clean.
Many people use trains to go to work, school, and shopping.
The weather in Tokyo has four seasons.
Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
Spring is very nice with cherry blossoms.
Summer can be hot and rainy.
Autumn has beautiful red and yellow leaves.
Winter is cold, but it usually does not snow a lot.
People in Tokyo speak Japanese.
Many people also learn English at school.
In big stores and hotels, you can find people who speak some English.
People in Tokyo are polite and helpful.
Tokyo is a city full of life, culture, history, and fun.
It is a city where you can see old temples and tall buildings.
You can eat traditional food and modern food.
You can enjoy quiet parks and busy streets.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I hope you liked learning about Tokyo today.
I am Emily.
